About Us

A Trusted Circle in
Professional Football

MBS Sport is a boutique football agency built on trust, discretion and long-term relationships. We work with a select number of players, clubs and partners, supporting careers and projects with the same care and responsibility we would give our own family.

With over 15 years of experience in the football industry, our work covers the full lifecycle of a professional career — from transfers and contract negotiations to long-term planning and support off the pitch. With a strong international network, we operate across key football markets in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

Our team brings together experience from across the game, including former professional players, senior club executives, sporting directors, legal specialists and financial advisors. This collective expertise allows us to approach every situation with a clear, informed and practical perspective.

Alongside player representation, we discreetly advise clubs and national teams on friendly matches, training camps and strategic football partnerships. Through our network, we also facilitate introductions and brokerage opportunities connected to football club ownership and investment.

To support our players beyond the pitch, we work with a trusted group of specialist partners in areas such as physiotherapy, personal player development and social media management — ensuring every aspect of a player’s career is carefully managed.

SR

Salman Rahimi

Founder & FIFA Licensed Football Agent

FIFA Licence No: 2024129838

Salman Rahimi is a FIFA licensed football agent and the founder of MBS Sport Consultancy. With over 15 years of experience in the game, he has built a reputation for operating with trust, discretion, and a strong understanding of both the professional and youth football landscape.

At MBS Sport, Salman oversees all player recruitment, management, and negotiations, working closely with clients and their families to provide a personalised, hands-on service. His approach is relationship-driven, ensuring every player is supported both on and off the pitch.

Through an extensive international network across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, Salman is actively involved in structuring transfers, sourcing opportunities, and guiding career development at every stage.

A graduate in Sports Science and Football Business, and fluent in multiple languages, he combines academic knowledge with real-world experience to deliver clear, honest advice in a competitive global market.

VI

Vlad Iacob

Club Governance & Strategy

Former President, Dinamo Bucharest · MSc Football Business, Johan Cruyff Institute / FC Barcelona

Vlad Iacob is a football executive and advisor with experience across club leadership, player representation, and football business strategy. He previously served as President of FC Dinamo Bucharest, where he oversaw club management during a critical restructuring period.

Vlad also spent five years working as a football agent, gaining direct experience in player representation, contract negotiations, and transfer market dynamics.

He holds a Master’s Degree in Football Business from the Johan Cruyff Institute in partnership with FC Barcelona, focusing on the commercial, operational, and governance aspects of the modern football industry.

At MBS Sport, he serves as an advisor, contributing strategic insight on football operations, club relations, and the broader European football ecosystem.

FB

Fouad Bachirou

Football Consultant

Former Professional Footballer · Comoros National Team & African Football Federations · UEFA Coaching Licence · MSc Sport Directorship

Fouad Bachirou is a former international footballer who brings his experience, network, and understanding of the professional game into athlete management and the agency. After a career shaped by high-level football and international competition, he has transitioned into agency work with a clear focus: helping players build successful careers.

Based on years of experience within elite football environments, Fouad offers insight into the sporting, personal, and strategic aspects of a player’s journey.

His transition into agency work is backed not only by experience on the field but also by formal education — including a coaching licence and a Master’s in Sport Directorship, along with a Level 2 qualification in talent identification. These qualifications reflect his commitment to understanding the game from every angle.

Fouad plays an important role in helping players maximise their potential and manage their careers both on and off the pitch.

PH

Pasha Hajian

FIFA Registered Agent & Lawyer

FIFA Licence No: 202507-11188 · Master of Laws (LL.M) · California State Bar · Active in football since 2018

Pasha Hajian is a lawyer and licensed FIFA football agent who has been active in the football industry since 2018. With a lifelong passion for the game, he leverages his legal background to assist with contract negotiations, legal disputes, and other matters essential to protecting and advancing his clients’ careers.

Pasha is admitted to the State Bar of California and is based in the United States, where he is dedicated to supporting athletes both on and off the field while providing trusted legal and professional guidance.

Pasha was also involved in the historic deal for Katayoun Khosrowyar, the first ever Iranian women’s coach to work in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) with Reign FC. He specialises in youth transfers and was involved in the record transfer of an FC Kia Academy player from Iran to La Liga side CD Leganés.

Salim Paolo serves as a dedicated Player Liaison at MBS Sport Consultancy, focusing on ensuring that players and their families feel settled, supported, and at home from the very first day.
